insights.headline: Silver jumps 3.6% on MCX as metals steady after slide to 14-month lows
insights.summary: MCX silver jumped 3.6% to ₹1,48,245 per kg as short-covering lifted metals off 14-month lows, with MCX gold holding near ₹1.23 lakh per 10 g and spot gold near $3,570 an ounce. Hot October PCE inflation at 3.8% and GDP revised up to 4.3% have hardened bets on a December Fed rate hike, while US markets stayed shut for Thanksgiving, keeping trading thin. Gold-loan lenders are meanwhile shifting to collections as falling prices push loan-to-value ratios toward regulatory caps.
points: MCX December silver jumped 3.6% to ₹1,48,245 per kg, touching ₹1,48,336, after falling 16% between November 17 and 25.
MCX gold held near ₹1.23 lakh per 10 g, with spot gold near $3,570 an ounce in thin Thanksgiving trading.
October US PCE inflation was 3.8% and core PCE 3.3%, with GDP revised up to 4.3%, hardening December Fed hike bets.
Gold-loan LTVs at some NBFCs crossed 75%, with segments breaching 85%, as lenders shift to collections.
The RBI held 880.52 tonnes of gold at September-end, with 740.13 tonnes, or 84%, stored in India.

brief.headline: MCX gold steadies near Rs 1.23 lakh as yields ease
brief.summary: MCX gold held near Rs 1.23 lakh per 10 g and silver near Rs 1.47 lakh per kg, spot gold near $3,581 as yields eased.

bullets.text: Hot October PCE at 3.8% and GDP revised up to 4.3% hardened December hike bets, while sliding yields and short-covering steadied metals.
The rupee eased to 92.40 after scaling an eight-month high, and MCX silver surged with gold after shedding Rs 8,800 per kg a day earlier.
US markets are shut for Thanksgiving; next is the ISM manufacturing PMI on Dec 1 at 20:30 IST, then US jobs and the RBI decision on Dec 4.

trending.title: Metals steady after the slide to 14-month lows
trending.summary: Gold steadied near $3,570 and silver near $41.30 after both hit their lowest in over a year, with MCX silver jumping 3.6% to ₹1,48,245 as short-covering lifted prices off the lows.

trending.title: Hot PCE and GDP keep December hike bets firm
trending.summary: October PCE inflation at 3.8% and GDP revised up to 4.3% have hardened bets on a December Fed hike, with markets also watching a further rise in early 2027.

trending.title: India's buyers step in as prices fall
trending.summary: Physical demand stayed firm despite the correction, the World Gold Council says, with buyers stepping in on dips and ETF inflows recovering in November.

trending.title: Gold loans feel the pinch as prices drop
trending.summary: Gold loan NPAs nearly doubled in six months as pledged gold lost value, and lenders are shifting to collections as LTVs cross 75% and near regulatory caps.

trending.title: London gold goes digital
trending.summary: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX completed the first live trades under the World Gold Council's digital gold initiative, trading fractional interests in 400-ounce bars without moving the metal.

items.title: Silver Prices Jump 3% on MCX to ₹1,48,336 per Kg; Kotak Neo Sees Scope for Further Recovery
items.summary: MCX December silver jumped 3.6% to ₹1,48,245 per kg in morning trade, touching an intraday high of ₹1,48,336, as short-covering drove a rebound from Wednesday's low of ₹1,36,712. Kotak Neo said the heavy selling leaves scope for further recovery if silver holds above ₹1,45,400, with ₹1,53,000 the next level in focus. Silver is still nearly 19% below its November 10 close.

items.title: Gold, silver prices rebound on MCX, Comex on buying at lower levels
items.summary: MCX December gold traded at ₹1,22,780 per 10 g, up ₹1,643, and silver at ₹1,47,513 per kg, up ₹4,996, as buyers stepped in after the slide to near one-year lows. Comex gold traded near $3,575 an ounce, with the rebound led by short-covering and lower-level buying.

items.title: Gold slips, silver steadies as Fed rate hike expectations persist in holiday trading
items.summary: Spot gold eased to about $3,569.90 an ounce in early US trading on Thursday while silver held near $41.30, Kitco reports, as expectations of further Fed rate increases kept buyers cautious despite lower Treasury yields. Trading stayed thin with US markets shut for Thanksgiving.

items.title: Gold steadies after hitting over 1-year low; Fed outlook in focus
items.summary: Spot gold steadied at $3,580.87 an ounce early Thursday after briefly falling below $3,500 on Wednesday, the first time since September 2025, Reuters reports, as investors covered shorts ahead of Thanksgiving; December futures rose 1.2% to $3,578.70. Silver rose 1% to $41.64. Hot US inflation and GDP revised up to 4.3% reinforced expectations of Fed rate hikes in December and early 2027.

items.title: MCX gold plunges ₹4,420/10g, silver sheds nearly ₹8,800/kg as PCE data fuels December Fed rate hike bets
items.summary: MCX gold fell 3.6% to ₹1,17,906 per 10 g and silver dropped ₹8,800 to ₹1,36,712 per kg on Wednesday evening, Mint reports, as hotter-than-target US inflation strengthened bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes and lifted the dollar.

items.title: PCE Inflation Rises to 3.8% as Stocks, Gold and Silver Weaken
items.summary: US PCE inflation rose 3.8% over the year to October, matching forecasts, while core PCE rose 3.3%, above the 3.2% expected. Both rose 0.3% on the month. Stocks fell after the release and gold and silver hit new lows for the day, with the dollar slightly weaker.

items.title: Gold prices drop another 1% as US Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% with contained PCE inflation
items.summary: US third-quarter GDP was revised up to 4.3% from the 3.4% advance estimate, Kitco reports, with the price index for gross domestic purchases up 2.7%. Spot gold fell to $3,484.20 an ounce, down nearly 2% on the day, as the strong growth data gives the Federal Reserve room to raise rates in December.

items.title: Dollar steady as sliding yields temper safe-haven bid
items.summary: The dollar was steady in Asian trade after falling to a one-week low overnight, Reuters reports, as sliding Treasury yields — the 10-year down to a 2.5-month low of 4.8% — offset safe-haven demand ahead of Thanksgiving. The dollar index was flat at 103.7, while sticky US inflation cemented bets on a December Fed hike and another in early 2027.

items.title: Gold price tracker, Nov 26: MCX gold rally reclaims ₹1.23 lakh, silver rates surge by ₹5,281/kg; further recovery ahead?
items.summary: MCX gold rallied 1.6% to an intraday high of ₹1,23,074 per 10 g in early trade on Thursday, while silver surged ₹5,281 per kg to ₹1,47,798, Upstox reports, as bullion tracked the global rebound on steady Treasury yields and value buying. At the 9 am open, gold was up ₹1,409 at ₹1,22,546 per 10 g and silver up ₹4,317 per kg.

items.title: Gold loan growth slows as falling gold prices push lenders into collection mode
items.summary: Gold-loan companies are shifting from growth to collections after the sharp fall in bullion pushed loan-to-value ratios higher, with portfolio LTVs at some NBFCs crossing 75% and certain segments breaching 85%. Lenders are asking borrowers to repay part of their loans or pledge more gold, and analysts expect stress to show in asset quality from the December quarter.

Silver traded 0.5% higher near $41.30 in European trading, recovering after hitting a fresh almost 15-month low of $38.20 the previous day, as US Treasury yields eased to a fresh two-month low near 4.80% and traders slightly trimmed bets on a larger January Fed hike. FXStreet notes rallies remain vulnerable while silver holds below its 20-day average near $46.99.
items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds ground amid setback in US bond yields
Gold demand remains strong despite price correction, says World Gold Council
items.summary: India's physical gold demand remains firm despite the correction, the World Gold Council's Sachin Jain said, with consumers buying on dips and ETF inflows recovering in the first half of November. Central banks bought more than 345 tonnes in the previous quarter, and gold ETF holdings were about 126 tonnes at end-October.

items.title: Rupee falls 20 paise to 92.40 against US dollar in early trade
items.summary: The rupee eased 20 paise to 92.40 against the dollar in early trade on Thursday, Economic Times reports, pulling back after hitting an eight-month high of 92.1850 in the previous session. A softer rupee raises the landed cost of gold imports even as global prices steady.

items.title: India Bullion: Fall to lowest in over a year; US tariff proposal weighs
items.summary: Gold and silver futures on MCX and COMEX fell further, Informist Media reports, as a stronger dollar and rate-hike bets weighed after US inflation data matched forecasts. MCX December gold closed down 1.6% at Rs 1,20,429 per 10 g and silver down 3.2% at Rs 1,40,797 per kg, while COMEX silver touched a near-15-month low of $39.56. A US tariff plan for 14 economies, including India, also weighed.

items.title: A big shift for gold trading? JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold deals- What to know
items.summary: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX completed London's first live trades under the World Gold Council's Wholesale Digital Gold initiative, Mint reports, using fractional ownership in standard 400-ounce bars as collateral without moving the metal. ICE Benchmark Administration ran the pilot with technology from Baton Systems, and the system is meant to work alongside the existing over-the-counter market.

items.title: Gold's 38% Collapse Exposes the Cost of Higher Interest Rates
items.summary: Spot gold fell 3.1% to $3,446.06 an ounce, below $3,500 for the first time since September 2025 and 38% under its late-January record of $5,589.38, Investing.com reports. Markets priced a 98% chance of a December Fed hike after core PCE came in at 3.3% and Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%, while gold failed as a safe haven as the Nasdaq fell over 4% on forced selling.

items.title: Bought SGB at ₹4,777 in 2021? RBI announces ₹12,612 redemption price; check your profit
items.summary: The RBI has fixed ₹12,612 per gram as the premature redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bonds 2021-22 Series I due on November 25, Upstox reports, a gain of about 164% over the May 2021 issue price of ₹4,777 per gram. The price is the average of IBJA 999-purity closing prices on November 19, 20 and 23.

items.title: RBI holds 84% of India's gold reserves domestically
items.summary: The RBI held 880.52 tonnes of gold at September-end, BusinessLine reports, with 740.13 tonnes, or 84%, stored in India, up from 680.05 tonnes in March as repatriation continued. Gold's share of total foreign exchange reserves fell to 14.38% from 16.7% as reserves grew.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD looks to build on recovery above $42.00
items.summary: Silver retook the $42.00 mark in Thursday's Asian session after bouncing from a $38.20 low, its lowest since August 2025, FXStreet reports, helped by dip-buying and lower US Treasury yields. The metal still faces resistance near the 100-hour average, with traders watching whether the recovery holds.

items.title: Pledged gold worth less as prices crash 30% from peak; gold loan NPAs nearly double, RBI cautions NBFCs
items.summary: Gold loan NPAs nearly doubled in six months, the ratio rising to 0.3% at the end of August from 0.16% in March, TransUnion CIBIL data cited in the report shows. With gold down nearly 30% from its peak near Rs 1.80 lakh, pledged gold is worth less and loan-to-value ratios are under pressure. The RBI has asked NBFCs to tighten scrutiny of gold-loan books and warned against rapid expansion.
